long_biography.plain_text:
Before turning to wine, Kourtesis built a long career in maritime operations. He worked as a captain, director and SIRE inspector with Haven Marine Services and represented SeaHawk Maritime in the Andros Maritime Association. He helped establish the association, served as its president and returned to the board as vice-president for 2025–2027.

On Andros, Kourtesis created a three-hectare estate around restored stone terraces above Chora. Its organically certified vineyards grow local and Cycladic varieties, while a cave winery, tastings and accommodation connect production with hospitality. The estate's team includes specialist vineyard and wine consultants, and Kourtesis has said its purpose is to strengthen Andros's reputation as a wine-producing island.

uncertainties.detail: Iakovos (Makis) Kourtesis resolves at 100 through an official formal-name-and-nickname record, exact Haven and SeaHawk career links, current association office and exact-person winery profile. The Piraeus Securities analyst Iakovos Kourtesis is a different person and no facts from that namesake were transferred.

Official association material gives the formal form Iakovos (Makis) Kourtesis, but Makis is the consistent public-facing name on his winery, LinkedIn and maritime records. The immutable display name and first name are therefore preserved; any formal-name normalisation should be handled as an alias-aware manual data-model decision rather than a silent replacement.
No reliable source established Kourtesis's birth day, month, year, place or country. Being described as Andrian or associated with Andros does not prove birthplace, so those fields remain blank.
Greece is supported by the exact LinkedIn location and continuing operating roles on Andros. No sufficiently strong source establishes a more specific principal residence or any secondary residence.

The record documents maritime-company ownership and a later winery, but not founding capital, inheritance, an actual asset transfer, independent start or family backing. Unknown is therefore the affirmative classification; self_made_independent is not inferred from business ownership.

Shipping & Maritime reflects the longest documented business platform and best available documented-origin fallback for wealth creation. Food & Beverage reflects the current first-party commercial role at Kourtesis Wine Estate. Neither classification assigns a personal net worth or claims that all current capital came from one sector.

The LinkedIn account is accepted because exact name, Greece, Haven Marine and SeaHawk identifiers converge. The winery team page qualifies as a type-14 exact owner/employer profile. No exact personal Instagram or personal website was strongly supported, and organisation accounts were not proposed as personal socials.

Those claims are omitted rather than transferring relatives' roles to Kourtesis.

The biographies cover durable public business, association and wine-estate work. They exclude all private-asset facts, company valuations, research narration, classification deliberation and unverified family details.
